title: WRCC2023-MI-A
description: A three-class motor imagery EEG dataset (left hand, right hand, feet) from the MI-A task of the 2023 World Robot Contest BCI competition. It includes 9 participants, two of whom are stroke patients, each completing 90 cued imagery trials (30 per class) recorded with a 59-channel wireless EEG system at 1000 Hz. This is a BIDS-formatted derivative produced with MOABB from the Harvard Dataverse deposit.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuracle 64-channel wireless system (59 EEG channels, 10-10 montage) at 1000 Hz. Participants performed cue-based, offline motor imagery of left-hand grasping, right-hand grasping, and foot hooking. Each trial was stored as a 4 s imagery epoch, with 90 trials per subject and no feedback.
